PLAYLIST_RECORDER.RecordTooltip: Record audio from your microphone to an .ogg file
PLAYLIST_RECORDER.WaveformLabel: Live waveform of the audio being recorded
PLAYLIST_RECORDER.NameHint: Saved to {folder} in User Data as Ogg Vorbis. Length {duration}, about {size} KB.
PLAYLIST_RECORDER.DiscardConfirm: This recording has not been saved. Discard it?
PLAYLIST_RECORDER.WarnSilent: The recording appears to be silent. Check your microphone input.
PLAYLIST_RECORDER.WarnQuiet: The recording is very quiet. Move closer to the microphone, or turn on Automatic Gain Control in the module settings.
PLAYLIST_RECORDER.ErrorNoMicrophoneApi: Microphone access is unavailable. Foundry must be opened over HTTPS or localhost.
PLAYLIST_RECORDER.ErrorEncode: Could not finish encoding the recording: {reason}
PLAYLIST_RECORDER.ErrorUploadUnknown: the server did not accept the upload
PLAYLIST_RECORDER.SettingQualityHint: Ogg Vorbis encoding quality. Foundry's bundled sounds are mostly about 256 kbps stereo.
PLAYLIST_RECORDER.SettingAutoGainHint: Let the browser raise quiet microphone input to a usable level. Phone and laptop microphones are often very quiet without it. Turn it off for unprocessed audio from an external microphone or interface.
